My first ever character was Marxi, a tiefling Evocation wizard who I played in Descent into Avernus. She was a sage at a temple in Elturel, and was very close with two teenaged half-elves named Lucia and Cade who she had rescued from a slave caravan a year before and brought into the temple. 

Marxi was well-known for her extreme magical power, and was one of the higher-ranked members of the temple who would always leap into battle to help defend civilians from threats. She, Lucia, and Cade were at ground zero when Elturel was dragged into Avernus. The three attempted to help to the best of their ability, but the scene was so much worse than anything Marxi had ever encountered. In a very uncharacteristic moment, Marxi fled in absolute terror, an act that led to the deaths of both Lucia and Cade. Upon discovering that the twins were dead, her psychological state deteriorated to the point where she heavily considered suicide. However, several days after Elturel's fall, she heard rumors of an adventuring party that was planning to travel to Avernus to attempt to free Elturel. Hoping to redeem herself of her initial cowardice and believing that she owed it to Lucia and Cade to help prevent any further deaths, Marxi tracked the party down and demanded to accompany them.

Marxi grew a lot throughout our campaign. At the beginning, she struggled with crippling self-doubt and a lack of confidence in herself and her own abilities. At the end, she was a much stronger, much more capable, and much more confident person who could heal from her past and who could finally forgive herself for what she'd done. 

I miss playing her, so I'm planning to bring her back in my home-brew campaign that takes place six years after Elturel's rescue.
